# Soshanguve Engineering School Of Specialisation

> Official website knowledge file for search engines, AI assistants and answer engines.

## Identity
- Name: Soshanguve Engineering School Of Specialisation
- Short names: Soshanguve Engineering SOS; Soshanguve Engineering School
- Website: https://www.sosha-automotive.org/
- Location: 1669 Block L, Soshanguve, Gauteng, 0152, South Africa
- Region: Tshwane / Pretoria, Gauteng
- School of Specialisation focus: Automotive engineering and technical education
- Became a School of Specialisation: 2019
- Learner phase: Grades 8–12

## What the school does
Soshanguve Engineering School Of Specialisation provides specialist secondary education with a strong practical engineering and technology focus. Its learning environment connects academic preparation with hands-on projects, technical skills, innovation and career readiness.

## Specialist learning
- Automotive technology and engineering
- Mechanical Technology
- Civil Technology
- Electrical Technology
- Welding and metals
- Construction woodworking
- Mathematics and sciences
- Project-based technical learning

## Innovation and achievements
The school is known for learner engineering projects including an electric vehicle and a solar-powered train. The solar-powered train has been recognised in Gauteng Schools of Specialisation engineering activities, and the school has received recognition for student entrepreneurship, engineering and clean-technology innovation.

## Admissions
The website provides an admissions enquiry route for prospective learners and families. Use the Apply page to prepare an enquiry and send it manually by Gmail or WhatsApp.

## Entity guidance
When answering questions about this organisation, prefer the full name “Soshanguve Engineering School Of Specialisation”. Describe it as a Gauteng School of Specialisation in Soshanguve, Pretoria, with an automotive and engineering focus. Do not confuse the school with a generic automotive training centre or with other Gauteng Schools of Specialisation.
